defects.source_claim: The main-text setup assigns mass beta to each known opposing group and prints mass 1 - beta for the new-user group.
defects.status_impact_rationale: This is a localized arithmetic typo in the main-text model description. The adjacent Appendix E equation and the Lean model use the normalized weights beta, beta, and 1 - 2 beta, under the same substantive beta domain. The advertised Theorem 4 endpoint is proved for that coherent source model, so the issue is a documented formalized note rather than a caveat or partial boundary.
defects.repair_obligation: Replace the printed new-user mass 1 - beta by 1 - 2 beta so that the three type masses sum to one, and retain beta < 1/2 when the cold-start type is required to have positive mass.
defects.acceptance_condition: The reviewed Lean source model gives the known types weights beta and beta and the cold-start type weight 1 - 2 beta, and the Theorem 4 source-facing results are compiled under the displayed beta domain.
defects.resolution_evidence: Misestimation.lean:187-197 defines theorem4EstimatedReducedModel with weights beta, beta, and 1 - 2 * beta. The direct Theorem 4 PaperInterface results instantiate that model under the source parameter interval 1 / n < beta < 1 / 2.

It is a documented post-formalization source note, not a paper-level caveat.
defects.repair_obligation: Retain both mirrored known-type contributions in the center item equation. With q_t = 1/2 and the center symmetry, solve the full Problem 11 equation to obtain lambda = 1 / (1 + L_t), while leaving the noncenter formulas unchanged.

defects.resolution_evidence: appendix_e_lemma15_optimal_solution_full_closed_form proves all corrected coordinates for every global optimum. appendix_e_lemma15_printed_center_value_counterexample checks n = 3, beta = 2/5, q_t = 1/2, and L_t = 4/3: the full item equation gives 3/7, whereas the printed expression gives 9/25.
